name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 8 – Am 75
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 8a. Emphasises that priority should be given to the mobilising of all existing budgetary resources; calls for savings to be identified, for the recovery of unduly spent Union funds, including in cases of fraud or irregularities, to be strengthened, and for rigorous expenditure management to be implemented before any recourse to additional budgetary instruments;
